questions.q: Which king reigned from India to Ethiopia, from Shushan the palace?
Why was queen Vashti put away?
questions.a: She refused to come at the king's commandment

questions.q: Who brought up Esther, his uncle's daughter?
What had Mordecai charged Esther not to show?
What plot did Mordecai make known?
questions.a: Two chamberlains sought to kill the king
w: Haman's plan to rob the treasury

questions.q: Why was Haman full of wrath against Mordecai?
questions.a: He would not bow nor do him reverence

questions.q: How did Haman fix the day to destroy the Jews?
questions.a: By casting Pur, that is, the lot

questions.q: Mordecai to Esther — complete it.
questions.text: and who knoweth whether thou art come to the [kingdom] for such a [time] as this?
questions.x: God is never named in Esther, yet his hand runs through every turn.

questions.q: 'I will go in unto the king... and if I perish, ___.' What did Esther say?
How long did Esther ask the Jews of Shushan to fast for her?
What did the king hold out to receive Esther?
What did Haman have made for Mordecai?
What happened the night the king could not sleep?
questions.a: The chronicles were read and Mordecai's deed was found

questions.q: Who had to lead Mordecai through the city in the king's apparel?
What became of Haman?
questions.a: He was hanged on the gallows he made for Mordecai

questions.q: Why could Haman's decree not simply be reversed?
questions.a: A writing sealed with the king's ring may no man reverse

questions.q: Which feast remembers the deliverance in Esther?
Why is the feast called Purim?
questions.a: After Pur, the lot Haman cast

questions.q: The name of God does not appear anywhere in the book of Esther.
questions.x: Yet deliverance comes 'from another place', and its timing is everything.

questions.q: Put these in the order Esther tells them.
items: Esther goes in to the king
